localChanges: Import assets now also takes SP299.PIC, which is optional, for the improvement and Wonder icons from the original game. With ?interface=new, they show beside each improvement and Wonder in the city screen, on its production card, and in the list of what to build (#64).
Importing assets again with "Replace existing assets?" unticked now skips the sprites you already have, instead of making them all again.

log: The 42 18×10 icons are cut where civd's draw_icon finds them, as city-improvements/<name> and wonders/<name> after the engine's class names (civ-clone/web-renderer#64). SP299.PIC is optional, listed in extract-data.json's new `optional`, so an existing import needs nothing more. PicImage skips the EGA colour map (E0) that comes before the VGA palette in SP299.PIC and most other sheets, and a sprite can be `opaque`, keeping palette index 0 black as the city screen draws these icons.
